_about: The watch list. size: your size exactly as the shop labels it ('L', 'W34 L32', 'UK 10'; 'L|XL' = either). target: buy-at price. variant: colour when one listing holds several. bought: true stops tracking everywhere. restock_watch: true keeps a sold-out piece on the list. brand + name are shown separately on the site. check: shopify | uniqlo | mands | barbour are checked live; manual = shop blocks bots (keep last_price + checked_on current by hand). role: what it is for outfits (jacket, overshirt, knit, cardigan, sweat, fleece, tee, jeans, chino, trouser, trainer, wallabee, boot, socks, underwear). fit.verdict: good | check | avoid (avoid = off-brief cut, never suggested). fit.reach: centre-back-to-cuff in cm per size. sizes.reach_cm: your own centre-back-to-wrist measurement, used to flag short sleeves.

items.name: Denim Trucker Jacket, olive

fit.note: Uniqlo list it as a regular fit with a shorter length, like every trucker: it should finish at your belt, not above it. Size XL if you'll layer a knit under it.

items.note: Replaces the sold-out Utility Blouson (end of season).

items.name: Milano Ribbed Shirt Collar Cardigan, olive
